final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type IN ('Residential (Continuous)', 'Residential (Temporary/Holiday)') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 88 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing residential dwelling to convert it into a micro-nursery for 18 children in Turin with at least 140 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing residential dwelling.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a micro-nursery.
clarifications.Cb: I have no requirement on building size, capacity or structural features.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: Preference for nearby public transport, using the 75th percentile threshold of 87.77 rounded to the nearest integer.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type IN ('Residential (Continuous)', 'Residential (Temporary/Holiday)') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 88 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters to the specified residential types, within 3 km of the supplied coordinates, with mobility score at least 88; orders by distance.
